name: Musk Ox Hide
body:
Aura faint abjuration and necromancy; CL 5th; Slot armor; Price 9,165 gp; Weight 25 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Coarse, wiry hair gives this +2 hide armor made from musk ox hide its shaggy appearance. The wearer of this armor gains cold resistance 5. On command, the armor emits a pungent musk some creatures find unpleasant.

Humanoids ending their movement within 5 feet of the wearer must succeed on a DC 14 Fortitude save or be sickened for 1 round. (The wearer is immune to this effect.) A humanoid who succeeds at his saving throw is immune to the effect from this set of armor for 24 hours. The wearer can suppress and reactivate the musk effect as a standard action. Creatures immune to poison are immune to this effect.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells ghoul touch, resist energy; Cost 4,665 gp.
